reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: A loan of up to USD 180 million to RGP Kazvodkhoz (the "Company" or the "Borrower"), wholly owned by the Government of Kazakhstan, for rehabilitation of the irrigation water conveyance infrastructure in South Kazakhstan, Zhambyl and Aktobe regions of Kazakhstan (the "Project"). The loan will be backed by a sovereign guarantee. The Project will help the Company to rehabilitate irrigation water conveyance infrastructure in South Kazakhstan, Zhambyl and Aktobe regions, provide rural employment, and make the water system more efficient and resilient to the impacts of climate change.
